passages.text: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song.
David sang this song to the LORD.
David sang because of the words of Cush.
Cush was a Benjamite.
This song is called a Shiggaion.

passages.text: O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers, or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this song.
David sang this song to the LORD.
David sang because of the words of Cush, a Benjamite.
David said, “O LORD, my God, I take refuge in You.”
David asked God to save him.
David asked God to deliver him from all his pursuers.
David said, “If You do not save me, my enemies will attack me.”
David said, “They will tear my soul like a lion.”
David said, “They will rip me apart.”
David said, “No one will rescue me if You do not help.”
passages.original: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֥ר לַיהוָ֑ה עַל־ דִּבְרֵי־ כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־ יְמִינִֽי׃ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־ רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃ פֶּן־ יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃

passages.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands, if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause, then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
passages.sermon:
David is speaking to the LORD his God.
David says, “O LORD my God, if I have done this thing.
If there is injustice in my hands.
If I have done evil to someone who was at peace with me.
If I have taken anything from my enemy without reason.
Then let my enemy chase me.
Let my enemy catch me.
Let my enemy trample my life to the ground.
Let my enemy lay my honor in the dust.
Selah.
Arise, O LORD, in Your anger.
Lift Yourself up against the rage of my enemies.
Awake for me.
You have commanded judgment.”
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־ יֶשׁ־ עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃ אִם־ גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃ יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀ נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י׀ לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃ ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀ בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃

passages.text: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
passages.sermon:
God rules over all nations.
Many peoples gather around God.
God sits above them in a high place.
God takes His seat to judge them.
passages.original: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃

passages.text: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the judge of all peoples.
The LORD judges everyone.
O LORD, judge me.
Judge me by my righteousness.
Judge me by my integrity.
My righteousness and integrity are before You.
passages.original: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
passages.sermon:
God is righteous.
God searches hearts and minds.
God, end the evil of the wicked.
God, establish the righteous.
passages.original: יִגְמָר־ נָ֬א רַ֨ע׀ רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃

passages.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
passages.sermon:
God protects me.
God is my shield.
God saves people who are upright in heart.
God rescues those who are honest and pure in their hearts.
passages.original: מָֽגִנִּ֥י עַל־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃

passages.text: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
passages.sermon:
God is righteous.
God judges people.
God is a judge who always does what is right.
God feels anger every day.
God is angry at evil each day.
God is a righteous judge who feels indignation daily.
passages.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־ יֽוֹם׃

passages.text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject.
God acts as a righteous judge.
If a person does not repent, God will act.
God will sharpen His sword.
God has bent His bow.
God has strung His bow.
passages.original: אִם־ לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃

passages.text: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
passages.sermon:
God is a righteous judge.
God feels indignation every day.
God has prepared deadly weapons.
God makes His arrows burn with fire.
passages.original: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־ מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃

passages.text: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man acts with evil intent.
He works hard to do wrong.
He creates trouble.
He gives birth to lies.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־ אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man acts with evil intent.
He digs a hole.
He hollows out a pit.
He falls into the pit he made himself.
passages.original: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָֽה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃

passages.text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man causes trouble.
His trouble returns to him.
His violence comes down on his own head.
He suffers the harm he planned for others.
passages.original: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קָ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃

passages.text: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to the LORD.
The LORD is righteous.
I will thank the LORD for His righteousness.
The LORD is Most High.
I will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
passages.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
